column3: A bus shelter on a busy sidewalk on an overcast day, the backlit portrait poster case at the end of the shelter is the chroma screen; two pedestrians walk past, one partly in front of the shelter.

Inside a modern underground metro station concourse with concrete and glass, three large landscape advertising panels in a row on the wall are the chroma screens; commuters with slight motion blur walk in front of them.

A historic city square at blue-hour dusk, a large wide rooftop LED billboard on top of an old red-brick corner building is the chroma screen (slightly glowing edges); traffic light trails and people on the square below.
A busy intersection at night with wet asphalt reflections, a huge landscape digital megaboard mounted on a building facade is the chroma screen; buses and cyclists in the foreground.

A pedestrian shopping street in autumn daylight, a freestanding double-sided digital street screen (portrait, about 2 m tall) in the middle is the chroma screen; shoppers walk by, one person in the foreground left edge out of focus.

A classical apartment building under renovation, its whole front covered by scaffolding with a giant landscape advertising mesh banner as the chroma screen; street with parked cars and a cyclist below, cloudy sky.
The grand hall of a historic railway station with a high timber ceiling and chandeliers, two tall portrait fabric banners hanging from the ceiling are the chroma screens; travellers with suitcases.
A bright airport baggage reclaim hall, a long landscape illuminated advertising wall behind the carousel is the chroma screen; travellers waiting with trolleys.
